youtube_description:
GPT‑6.2 Astra entered preview in ChatGPT Work on November 17. Try it on a low-stakes Excel report with a known answer. This episode uses an invented orders CSV and shows what to ask for and what to check before sharing the workbook.

In ChatGPT Work, choose GPT‑6.2 Astra if you have access. Attach an approved sample CSV and ask for the source rows, a totals sheet and inspectable formulas. Open the file, trace the calculations and recompute a few totals yourself. OpenAI's published workbook examples are provider evidence. We did not run an independent workbook test.

Preview availability depends on your plan and workspace settings. Follow AI Daily Diff for AI updates that change a real task at work.
